# Behance
> Behance is Adobe’s platform for showcasing creative work, discovering projects, finding jobs, and hiring creative talent.

Behance combines portfolio publishing, project discovery, creative networking, freelance hiring, and career opportunities for designers, illustrators, photographers, motion artists, and other creative professionals. It also connects with Adobe services such as Adobe Portfolio and Creative Cloud.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://www.behance.net/): Main discovery feed for creative projects, portfolios, and featured work.
- [About Behance](https://www.behance.net/about): Overview of Behance’s mission, platform, and creative community.
- [Search](https://www.behance.net/search/projects): Search interface for browsing projects across creative disciplines.
- [Galleries](https://www.behance.net/galleries): Directory of creative categories and curated project collections.
- [Best of Behance](https://www.behance.net/galleries/behance): Curated selection of standout projects featured by Behance.
- [Adobe Portfolio](https://portfolio.adobe.com/): Portfolio website builder closely associated with Behance publishing workflows.

## Discover Creative Work
- [Graphic Design](https://www.behance.net/galleries/graphic-design): Explore branding, editorial, poster, and visual communication projects.
- [UI/UX](https://www.behance.net/galleries/ui-ux): Browse interface, product, interaction, and user experience design work.
- [Illustration](https://www.behance.net/galleries/illustration): Discover editorial, commercial, character, and digital illustration projects.
- [Photography](https://www.behance.net/galleries/photography): View photography portfolios spanning fashion, documentary, product, and fine art.
- [Motion Graphics](https://www.behance.net/galleries/motion-graphics): Explore animation, title design, and motion-driven visual storytelling.
- [Branding](https://www.behance.net/galleries/branding): Browse identity systems, logos, packaging, and brand strategy presentations.
- [Architecture](https://www.behance.net/galleries/architecture): Discover architectural visualization, interiors, and built environment projects.
- [Fashion](https://www.behance.net/galleries/fashion): Explore fashion design, styling, textiles, and apparel-related creative work.

## Jobs & Hiring
- [Creative Jobs](https://www.behance.net/joblist): Job board for creative roles, freelance work, and design opportunities.
- [Hire Freelancers](https://www.behance.net/hire): Hiring hub for finding freelance designers and creative professionals.
- [Create a Project Request](https://www.behance.net/hire/createProjectFlow): Workflow for submitting a hiring request to connect with talent.
- [Find Graphic Designers](https://www.behance.net/hire/graphic-designers): Talent discovery page focused on freelance graphic designers.
- [Find UI/UX Designers](https://www.behance.net/hire/ui-ux-designers): Talent discovery page for product, interface, and UX specialists.
- [Find Illustrators](https://www.behance.net/hire/illustrators): Hiring page for sourcing freelance illustration talent.
- [Find Brand Designers](https://www.behance.net/hire/brand-designers): Browse and hire creatives specializing in branding and identity.
- [Find Photographers](https://www.behance.net/hire/photographers): Talent page for photography professionals and visual storytellers.

## Membership & Professional Tools
- [Behance Pro](https://www.behance.net/pro): Premium subscription with tools and benefits for professional growth.
- [Adobe Portfolio](https://portfolio.adobe.com/): Build a personalized portfolio website using Adobe’s hosted portfolio service.
- [Creative Cloud](https://www.adobe.com/creativecloud.html): Adobe’s creative software ecosystem connected to Behance workflows.
- [Adobe Express](https://www.adobe.com/express/): Adobe’s lightweight creation tool for social, marketing, and visual content.
- [Substance 3D](https://www.adobe.com/products/substance3d.html): Adobe’s 3D design suite relevant to Behance’s 3D and motion creators.

## Blog & Editorial
- [Behance Blog](https://www.behance.net/blog): Editorial content covering creative trends, platform news, and artist features.
- [Interviews](https://www.behance.net/blog/category/interviews): Conversations with creatives about process, careers, and inspiration.
- [Inspiration](https://www.behance.net/blog/category/inspiration): Articles highlighting notable work, trends, and visual ideas.
- [Career](https://www.behance.net/blog/category/career): Advice and stories related to creative careers and professional growth.
- [News](https://www.behance.net/blog/category/news): Product updates, announcements, and community-related platform news.

## Community & Support
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.behance.net/misc/community): Rules and expectations for participating on Behance safely and respectfully.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.adobe.com/legal/terms.html): Adobe’s legal terms governing use of Behance and related services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.adobe.com/privacy/policy.html): Adobe privacy information covering data practices for Behance users.
- [Copyright](https://www.adobe.com/legal/copyright.html): Copyright guidance, ownership information, and infringement reporting details.
- [Help Center](https://help.behance.net/hc/en-us): Support portal for account, publishing, and platform troubleshooting.
- [Contact](https://www.behance.net/about/contact): Contact options for reaching Behance regarding support and inquiries.

## Opportunities & Programs
- [Commissions](https://www.behance.net/resources/commissions): Resource page for commissioned work and creative opportunity programs.
- [Adobe Creative Apprenticeship](https://www.behance.net/resources/commissions): Information related to Adobe-supported creative opportunity initiatives.
- [Live Streams](https://www.behance.net/live): Behance live content featuring creative process, talks, and community sessions.
- [Events](https://www.behance.net/live/events): Scheduled live events and programming for the Behance community.

## For Creatives
- [Create a Portfolio](https://www.behance.net/): Start publishing projects and building a public creative presence.
- [Discover Inspiration](https://www.behance.net/search/projects): Browse projects to research styles, techniques, and industry trends.
- [Find Freelance Work](https://www.behance.net/joblist): Search creative job listings and freelance opportunities.
- [Build a Personal Site](https://portfolio.adobe.com/): Launch a custom portfolio website linked to your creative work.
- [Grow Your Visibility](https://www.behance.net/pro): Access premium tools intended to support professional exposure and growth.

## For Recruiters & Clients
- [Hire on Behance](https://www.behance.net/hire): Start sourcing freelance creative talent through Behance.
- [Post a Project Need](https://www.behance.net/hire/createProjectFlow): Submit a brief to receive matches from relevant creatives.
- [Browse Creative Categories](https://www.behance.net/galleries): Explore discipline-specific galleries to identify suitable talent.
- [Search Projects](https://www.behance.net/search/projects): Review published work to evaluate style, quality, and fit.
- [Explore Creative Jobs](https://www.behance.net/joblist): View the jobs marketplace and hiring-related opportunities on Behance.
